text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHCDOG01, Labrador Front Door Knocker

The Labrador Retriever Door Knocker is a great way to let your visitors know about the person and the dog living in your home. This wonderfully detailed Labrador Front Door Knocker captures the playfulness and devotion that labs are known for. This door knocker is made from brass with a Oiled Bronze finish that really bring out the beauty of not only the coloring, but also the detailing. This Labrador Retriever Front Door Knocker comes packaged with the mounting hardware to install it on wood or metal doors.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Also see other Michael Healy Door Knockers

Features and Specifications of the Premium Solid Bronze Labrador Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 5-1/2"
  • Width: 4-3/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 3-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
